source.title: Indiana Certified Drinking Water Laboratories (IDEM in-state list)
limitations: Transcribed only the IDEM PDF section “Labs that accept samples from the public” (revised 11/7/2025). A separate section “Labs that do not accept samples from the public” is not tabulated; see the PDF.
Municipal utilities that appear in the public-accepting section are included (unlike OH/MI directories where municipal plants were omitted because those lists did not claim public acceptance).

Appearance on the list is not an endorsement. Call before you collect. Private-well acceptance beyond the PDF’s “accept samples from the public” wording is not independently verified except for Indiana Dept. of Health Laboratories (IDOH well-water page).

The PDF text layer is multi-column; City of Goshen Water Lab and Elkhart Public Works & Utilities Laboratory both print lab ID M-20-01; Pace Analytical Services, LLC (Indianapolis) prints only C-49-06 (same C-id string as EMSL). Kept as printed.
Certification analyte lists may be truncated with “…’ in summaries; full text is in certification_full. Prices are intentionally omitted even when the IDOH well-water page shows dollar amounts.
Mail vs. drop-off is unknown unless noted. Order kits for IDOH via Access Indiana per the IDOH well-water page; kit process details beyond that page are not invented.
